dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent O-shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank feature high-intensity white perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from the dark-gray exterior coat to a lighter-gray interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid, high-intensity white clusters is observed in the anterior dorsal and cervical regions, characterized by a lack of internal intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest mid-lateral annuli form an elongated irregular quadrilateral, while a cluster of three high-intensity blobs on the neck forms a nearly equilateral triangle.
